purpose: Integrity and access controls for racing analysis, simulated wagering trials and result evaluation without enabling hidden or unauthorised betting actions.
requirements: Private racing analysis and trial records require authenticated and authorised access.
State-changing browser requests enforce origin and CSRF protections.
Credential endpoints are throttled, bounded and use generic authentication failures.
Trial selections, strategies and evaluation records preserve stable identifiers and timestamps so later results can be traced to the decision that existed beforehand.
Historical strategy versions are immutable or versioned so backtests cannot silently use future logic.
Race results and price observations preserve source, event identity and observation timing; missing or stale evidence is not silently represented as current.
Trial evaluation distinguishes simulated or bonus-bet records from real-money wagering and does not silently convert one into the other.
Ledger and reconciliation logic is deterministic, auditable and does not fabricate settlement when result evidence is incomplete.
Imported results and externally sourced race data are schema validated and bounded before persistence.
Model or heuristic scores remain analysis signals rather than authority to execute a wager.
No secret, password or privileged session credential is exposed in client code, logs or analysis output.
Explicit sign-out revokes or invalidates the relevant session where the authentication architecture supports revocation.
When identity, result provenance or ledger integrity cannot be established, protected mutations and settlement fail closed.
nonClaims: This policy does not predict winners or guarantee profitability.
This policy does not certify a strategy as suitable for gambling with real money.
This policy does not authorise autonomous bet placement.
This policy does not remove the financial risks of gambling.
